title: Metal Price Holding Windows and Stone Sourcing Fees by Programme
content:
# Metal Price Holding Windows and Stone Sourcing Fees by Programme

Each programme of Belrose Design Studio Custom Commissions holds the metal price behind a quote for a set number of calendar days before the quote is rebuilt, either passes a movement in the metal price after that window on to the customer or absorbs it, and charges a fee for sourcing a stone to order as a percentage of the stone's cost. The three parameters by programme:

## Terms

| Programme | Metal price held for (calendar days) | Metal movement passed on to the customer | Stone sourcing fee (share of the stone's cost) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting | 30 | no | 0 per cent |
| Design Studio Custom Setting | 30 | yes | 6 per cent |
| Belrose Bespoke Design | 45 | yes | 8 per cent |
| Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission | 60 | yes | 8 per cent |
| Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission | 45 | yes | 6 per cent |
| Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission | 90 | yes | 12 per cent |

## Reading the terms

- The window is a count of calendar days; the two Design Studio programmes hold the price for 30 days, Belrose Bespoke Design and the Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission for 45, the Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission for 60 and the Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission for 90.
- The Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting is the one programme that does not pass a metal movement on to the customer; every other programme does.
- The stone sourcing fee is nil under the Design Studio Semi-Custom Setting (0 per cent), 6 per cent under the Design Studio Custom Setting and the Belrose Heritage Redesign Commission, 8 per cent under Belrose Bespoke Design and the Belrose Bespoke Signature Commission, and 12 per cent under the Belrose Atelier One-of-a-Kind Commission.

## Hypothetical

A stone sourced to order at a cost of USD 4000.00 for a Belrose Bespoke Design commission carries a sourcing fee of 8 per cent of USD 4000.00, USD 320.00.
